results.title: Najeriya ta tabbatar babu sabbin kamuwa da Ebola bayan ƙillace mutum 62
results.content: Hukumar Yaƙi da Cututtuka Masu Yaɗuwa ta Najeriya NCDC ta tabbatar da cewa babu ko mutum ɗaya da ya kamu da cutar Ebola daga cikin mutane 62 da aka ƙillace tsawon kwanaki 21, lamarin da ke na nufin an daƙile yaɗuwar cutar a cikin gida.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Ana tsare da ƴan ƙasar Mali 11 a gidan gyaran hali na Suleja a Abuja
results.content: Babbar kotun tarayya da ke Abuja ta bayar da umarnin a tsare ƴan ƙasar Mali guda 11 a gidan gyaran hali na Suleja a Abuja, bisa zarge-zargen sace mutane domin neman kudin fansa da kuma safarar mutane. Alkalin kotun, Justice Obiora Egwuatu, ya bayar da umarnin a tsare su bayan sun musanta tuhume-tuhume guda hudu da aka gabatar a kansu a cikin takardar tuhuma da aka yi wa kwaskwarima.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Mali, Nijar da Burkina Faso,su shiga tattaunawa da masu jihadi na JNIM -ICG
results.content: Rahotanni daga ɗaya daga cikin kungiyoyi masu bincike domin tattance hanyoyin samar da zaman lafiya mai zaman kanta da ta kware a wannan fani wato, ICG ta ba da shawarar ga gwamnatocin sojan yankin Sahelda suka hada da Mali, Nijar da Burkina Faso, da ke cikin kawancen ƙasashen Sahel wato AES da su shiga tattaunawa da masu jihadi na Jnim, masu alaka da al-Qaeda.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: CAF ta ayyana goyon baya ga shugaban FIFA Infantino domin neman wa'adi na 2
results.content: Hukumar Ƙwallon Ƙafa ta Afirka CAF ta ayyana cikakken goyon bayanta ga sake zaɓen Gianni Infantino a matsayin Shugaban Hukumar Ƙwallon Ƙafa ta Duniya FIFA.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: CAF ta sanar da samun ribar sama da dala miliyan 31 a shekarar 2025
results.content: Hukumar Ƙwallon Ƙafa ta Afirka CAF ta sanar da samun ribar dala miliyan 31.2 a shekarar 2025 da 2026, tare da samun jimillar kuɗaɗen shiga da suka kai dala miliyan 284.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Babbar kotun tarayya da ke Abuja ta soke takarar Ribadu na jam'iyyar ADC a Adamawa
results.content: Babbar kotun tarayya da ke Abuja ta soke zaɓen Tukur Ribadu a matsayin ɗan takarar gwamna na jam'iyyar ADC a jihar Adamawa, tare da umartar hukumar zaɓe mai zaman kanta ta ƙasa (INEC) da ta mayar da Omar Suleiman a matsayin ɗan takarar jam'iyyar.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Bensedrine za ta fuskanci hukuncin ɗaurin shekaru biyar a gidan yarin Tunisia
results.content: An yanke wa wata babbar jigo a fannin kare hakkin ɗan Adam ta Tunisia, Sihem Bensedrine hukuncin ɗaurin shekaru biyar a gidan yari bayan wani zaman kotu a jiya juma’a.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Majalisar sojin Burkina Faso ta rusa ƙungiyar masu magunguna ta ƙasa (SPBF)
results.content: A Burkina Faso,majalisar ministoci ta rusa ƙungiyar masu magunguna ta ƙasa (SPBF) a ranar Alhamis da ta gabata, bayan da aka zarge ta da yin amfani da karfi wajen tilasta wa masu rarraba magunguna su kara farashin magunguna a Burkina Faso.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Mutane shida suka mutu bayan wani harin Isra’ila yankin Zirin Gaza
results.content: Akala mutane shida ne suka mutu biyo bayan wani hari da Isra’ila ta kai yankin Zirin Gaza a jiya juma’a.Rundunar tsaron fararen hula ta yankin Falasdinu ta shaida wa AFP cewa sojojin Isra'ila sun yi ikirarin kai hari kan mayakan Hamas, duk da cewa yarjejeniyar tsagaita wuta da aka cimma a ka'ida tana aiki.

results.title: Somalia ta umurci jakadan Haɗaddiyar Daular Larabawa da ya bar ƙasar cikin sa'o'i 72
results.content: Somalia ta umurci jakadan Hadaddiyar Daular Larabawa (UAE) da ya bar kasar cikin sa'o'i 72, tare da janye nata jakadan daga Abu Dhabi, bisa zargin keta dokokin ƙasa da ƙasa.

results.title: Larabawa makiyaya 800 da aka kora a Nijar sun isa Chadi
results.content: Akalla Larabawa makiyaya 800 daga kabilar Mahamid ne suka isa ƙasar Chadi sakamakon korar su da hukumomin Nijar suka yi daga yankin Diffa saboda dalilan tsaro.

results.title: Mu zagaya Duniya, shirin da ke waiwaye kan wasu muhimman labaran da suka faru
results.content: Za a soma shirin daga yankin Asiya inda shugabannin ƙasashen China, da Amurka, da kuma Rasha suka fitar da sanarwar haɗin gwiwa da ke fayyace ƙudurorin da suka tattauna a kansu, bayan taron kwanaki biyu da suka gudanar a birnin Shenzhen, da ke kudu maso gabashin ƙasar Sin.

results.title: Dandalin siyasa,shirin da ke kawo muku irin wainar da ake toyawa a fagen siyasa
results.content: A wannan makon, majalisun dokokin jihohi 36 na Najeriya sun amince da kudirin kafa ƴansandan jihohi. Sai dai yayin da ake murnar wannan mataki, wasu na nuna fargabar cewa gwamnonin jihohi za su iya amfani da wannan runduna wajen musgunawa ƴan adawa.

results.title: Ana fargabar mutuwar mutane 30 a haɗarin jirgin ruwa a Bayelsa
results.content: Akalla mutane 30 ake fargabar sun mutu sakamakon kifewar da wani ƙaramin jirgin ruwa ya yi a Jihar Bayelsa dake Najeriya, lokacin da ya ke ɗauke da masu zaman makoki.

results.title: Najeriya ta yi asarar ɗaya daga cikin marubutan arewacin ƙasar Jamila Umar Tanko
results.content: Allah ya yiwa ɗaya daga cikin fitacciyar marubuciyar arewacin Najeriya Jamila Umar Tanko rasuwa sakamakon rashin lafiya.

results.title: Tsohon kaftin ɗin Najeriya Odegbami ya tsallake rijiya da baya
results.content: Tsohon Kaftin ɗin Najeriya Segun Odegbami ya tsallake rijiya da baya, lokacin da wasu ɓarayi su ka kai masa hari gidan sa dake Abeokuta daren jiya, inda suka sare shi da adda.

results.title: An samu raguwar tashe-tashen hankula daga Boko Haram - Rahoto
results.content: Wani rahoto da ga cibiyar sa ido kan tashe-tashen hankula ACLED ya nuna cewa an samu raguwar tashe-tashen hankula daga ƙungiyar Boko Haram a Najeriya tun daga kwata na farko na shekarar 2026.
